summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp filed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Exxon Mobil Corporation issued $185.883 million of Floating Rate Notes due 2076 under an underwriting agreement dated September 23, 2026 with RBC, Deutsche Bank, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and UBS as managers. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the parent and issued off an existing Form S-3 shelf. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no change to equity capital structure, ownership or control. Watch only general credit spreads and the 2076 maturity's rate reset mechanics.
